positronDeck.deploy.provider.description: Deployment provider. No deployment is configured by default.

positronDeck.deploy.task.description: Exact VS Code task label for the task deployment provider.

positronDeck.deploy.command.description: Shell command used only by the custom deployment provider. Do not embed credentials.

positronDeck.confirmDeploy.description: Ask before deploying. Custom shell deployments always require confirmation.

positronDeck.showNotifications.description: Show transient completion status messages. Errors are always shown.

positronDeck.logging.level.description: Diagnostic verbosity. Code, credentials and raw provider errors are never logged.

positronDeck.testing.provider.description: Prefer a detected native Test Explorer run profile, then R packages, then pytest. Override if native detection is unavailable.

positronDeck.r.executable.description: Optional absolute R executable for process fallbacks. Otherwise use the Positron runtime, then R on PATH.

positronDeck.python.executable.description: Optional Python executable for process fallbacks. Otherwise use the Positron runtime, then python on PATH. Set this to your virtual environment in VS Code.

positronDeck.quarto.executable.description: Quarto CLI executable used when a suitable Quarto extension command is unavailable.

positronDeck.workflows.description: Named IDE-side workflows. Custom workflows always request confirmation. Task steps wait for exit code zero. Commands only guarantee dispatch.

positronDeck.workflowSlots.description: Workflow names for the eight dedicated Stream Deck slot actions.
